resolution.note: task publish and lane run ship through cliShipRuntime; fixture test exits 82 before any push; rule test pins every shipCommand caller

title: krn task publish ships with the same guards as krn pr ship
body: Source: lead session 2026-11-16 review of #1201: src/cli/task-publish.ts calls shipCommand with only baseOf and proofOf, while src/cli/pr.ts also injects deployRefusal, completeClose and releaseClaim; src/ci/ship.ts:367 treats a missing deployRefusal as no refusal.

Outcome: `krn task publish` ships with the same dependencies as `krn pr ship` (one exported dependency set in src/cli/pr.ts), overriding only proofOf, so a repository that deploys on push to its base is refused with exit 82 exactly as `krn pr ship` refuses it.
Why: publish will run in adopted repositories; a tasks-only PR must not auto-merge into a deploying base without the acknowledgement.
Proof: `node --test test/cli/task-publish.test.ts` with a fixture whose base deploys on push and no "deploy": "acknowledged": publish exits 82 before any push (fake gh records no push).
